mapper.select: SELECT t1.TR_CO_CD AS tr_co_cd , t1.GR_CD AS gr_cd , gr.SEBU_CD_NM AS xx_gr_cd , t1.SCD AS scd , t1.SNM AS snm , t1.COMPANY AS company , t1.URL AS url , t1.HEADERS AS headers , t1.QUERYPARAMS AS queryparams , t1.TABLENAME AS tablename , t1.SUBTABLE AS subtable , t1.KEY_VALUE AS key_value , t1.SUB_KEY_VALUE AS sub_key_value , t1.COMMENTS AS comments , t1.Q_VALUE AS q_value FROM API_PARAMS t1 , szx0gr gr WHERE t1.TR_CO_CD = #{trCoCd} AND gr.GR_CD = 'AP' AND gr.SEBU_CD = t1.GR_CD ORDER BY t1.GR_CD ASC, t1.SCD ASC, t1.COMPANY ASC
